Usage: yantra show [options] <target>

Display a saved workflow or run

Arguments:
  target        Workflow name OR run-id

Options:
  --workflow    force workflow lookup
  --run         force run lookup
  --events <n>  number of recent events to display for a run (default: "20")
  --json        emit JSON instead of human-readable output (default: false)
  -h, --help    display help for command
